scientific_integrity: The integral homotopy claim is supported by a standalone exhaustive acyclic discrete-Morse matching, signed integer attaching-degree verification, primitive minors, and an independent modular chain-complex check. No empirical approximation or incomplete enumeration is used.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact nonequivariant homotopy classifications for the two named sixteen-vertex graphs only. An unindexed equivalent prior calculation cannot be excluded; independent mathematical review has not been performed.
title: Induced-forest complexes of the Shrikhande and rook graphs
